name: HTML Preview
summary: See an HTML page or a Markdown file next to the editor, updated as you type.
about:
Opens the preview beside the editor for the active HTML or Markdown file (**Ctrl+K V**). The page reloads when you save, and links to CSS, scripts and images next to the file work, since it is served from its folder.

In a folder with an `index.html`, the Run view gets a **Preview index.html** button.
agent: The user can preview HTML in FluxCode (Ctrl+K V); after changing a page, tell them to look at the preview instead of opening a browser.
